### [`figure_limbs_unused`](../../../src/figure_sprites_d000.asm#L6) `$D000`

<a id="figure_head_old_b"></a>
### [`figure_head_old_b`](../../../src/figure_sprites_d000.asm#L36) `$D140-$D17F`

*data*

Unused block (pointer $45): a head, a near copy of $c940 (12 bits differ).

<a id="figure_f70_parts"></a>
### [`figure_f70_parts`](../../../src/figure_sprites_d000.asm#L42) `$D180-$D2BF`

*data*

Second set, parts $46-$4a: frame 70 of the small figure, with one arm up. Part $47 is also in frame 68. Part $4f is in frames 70 and 71.

<a id="figure_f71_parts"></a>
### [`figure_f71_parts`](../../../src/figure_sprites_d000.asm#L151) `$D2C0-$D3FF`

*data*

Second set, parts $4b-$4f: frame 71 of the small figure. The CPU sees I/O here ($01=$05), so only the VIC can show these blocks directly.

<a id="figure_parts_unused"></a>
### [`figure_parts_unused`](../../../src/figure_sprites_d000.asm#L260) `$D400`

*data*

Unused blocks, pointers $50-$54: small fragments (a hand, a foot, an arm). No table names these numbers.
